items.title: Anthropic confirms Claude Code prompt steers away from cloning specific games
items.summary: The Verge／Tom's Hardware 報道 Anthropic 員工確認，已喺 Claude Code（Opus 5.5）系統提示加入兩句，避免重製特定現有遊戲以符合知識產權政策；原作、類型遊戲同用戶自有資產仍允許。用戶亦反映逆向工程相關請求有時被拒，範圍仍在迭代。
items.note: Verge timestamp Nov 2, 2026 6:56 PM UTC → HKT Nov 3 ~02:56
items.imageAlt: Anthropic brand illustration from The Verge

items.title: OpenAI introduces LifeVal to measure AI on everyday life tasks
items.summary: OpenAI 推出 LifeVal，用時間運用調查同約 3,995 人問卷揀出育兒、醫療、教育、理財等日常任務，量度模型喺瀏覽、電腦操控同連接器上嘅實用表現。官方話目標係令 ChatGPT 更似可執行實際行動嘅個人助理。
items.imageAlt: OpenAI LifeVal social card

items.title: OpenAI details Pando, a Git-compatible backend for agent-scale monorepo pushes
items.summary: OpenAI 工程文介紹自研 Git 後端 Pando：喺唔改工程師 Git 工作流下支援大量並行分支推送同高吞吐讀取，指中位 push 延遲約減五倍，高峰一小時可送出逾 57TB pack。團隊亦提到會繼續向上游 Git 貢獻改進。
items.imageAlt: OpenAI Scaling Git at OpenAI card

items.title: Egzakta AI Lab open-weights KVARK Sparkle 1.0 27B reasoning model
items.summary: Egzakta AI Lab 喺 Hugging Face 開源 KVARK Sparkle 1.0（基於 Qwen3.8-27B），Apache-2.0，提供 BF16／FP8／GGUF。團隊自測指 thinking token 最多減少約 67%、中位回應約快一倍，五項標準基準準確率差異未達統計顯著。
items.note: LocalLLaMA/official post timestamp 11-02 13:48; HF model card is primary weights URL

items.title: Deep Principle open-weights Hydrogen-1.0 scientific discovery model
items.summary: Deep Principle 發布 Hydrogen-1.0：喺 GLM-5.3 上做化學／材料／生命科學後訓練嘅開源權重科學模型，MIT 授權，並提供 Hugging Face／ModelScope 下載同 API。公司自稱喺 FrontierScience-Research 上勝過 GPT-6-Astra（自報結果）。
items.imageAlt: Deep Principle Hydrogen-1.0 logo

items.title: Mistral posts improved Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk) open weights for coding and cyber
items.summary: Mistral 官網宣布放出改進版 Mistral Large 4（約 1T／約 52B 活躍）開源權重，強調 agentic coding 同防禦性網絡安全；支援 low／medium／high 三檔推理，並可於 Hugging Face 下載。IT Brief 等二次來源標 11 月 2 日；HF 早期介紹帖標 10 月 29 日，精確「今日」日曆日有歧義。
items.note: uncertain: page undated ('Today'); IT Brief dated Nov 2 2026; related HF blog dated Oct 29 2026
items.imageAlt: Mistral Large 4 open-weight announcement cover

items.title: HKGAI, Du Xiaoman and HKUST launch XuanYuan 4.5 self-evolving finance model
items.summary: 香港生成式 AI 研發中心、度小滿同科大喺金融科技周推出「玄元 4.5」金融大模型，稱用遞迴自我改進技術；HKGAI 指喺獲客、風控、客戶關係等場景性能提升約 30%，推論成本約為通用模型一成（機構自述）。
items.note: Standard page showed '16 hours ago' relative to fetch afternoon Nov 3 HKT; treated as FinTech Week Nov 2 coverage
items.imageAlt: XuanYuan 4.5 launch ceremony photo

items.title: HKMA launches Project SAGE and Agentic Finance Expert Group
items.summary: 金管局 11 月 2 日公布 Project SAGE（Securing Agentic Finance with Governance and Enablement），聚焦用例探索、Agent 身份（KYA）、互通標準同法規框架，並成立 Agentic Finance Expert Group。總裁余偉文指希望喺創新同時維護金融體系穩定。
items.imageAlt: HKMA share image

items.title: SFC survey: 30% of large Hong Kong finance firms already use agentic AI
items.summary: 證監會公布大型機構 AI 準備調查：受訪 20 間大型金融機構中，30% 已用 agentic AI、25% 試行；95% 預期未來 12 個月加快採用。證監會強調安全優先、人類負責同協作監管，並提醒控制應同代理權限同影響相稱。
items.imageAlt: SFC logo

items.title: HSBC announces AI & Emerging Technology Institute in Hong Kong Northern Metropolis
items.summary: 滙豐喺香港金融科技周宣布將喺北部都會區設立全球 AI 及新興科技研究所，目標 2027 年初運作，初期聚焦 AI 培訓、安全、欺詐偵測、後量子密碼同區塊鏈；科大為主要學術夥伴。

items.title: Hong Kong retail: Centralfield lists NVIDIA DGX Spark Founders Edition at HK$55,800 in stock
items.summary: 深水埗中田 Centralfield 頁面標示 NVIDIA DGX Spark Founder's Edition（GB10／128GB／4TB）現貨價 HK$55,800，並寫免費送貨上門。實際庫存與是否 Founders 渠道以門市／客服即時確認為準。
items.note: Price/stock checked afternoon 2026-11-03 HKT from retailer page
items.imageAlt: NVIDIA DGX Spark product image on Centralfield

items.title: Future Computer lists DGX Spark 128GB/4TB at HK$53,500 on back order
items.summary: 灣仔未來科技電腦頁面列出同規格 NVIDIA DGX Spark（128GB／4TB）標價 HK$53,500，狀態為訂貨／schema 顯示 BackOrder。頁面提醒價格同供貨隨市場變動，落單前宜再確認。
items.note: Price/availability checked afternoon 2026-11-03 HKT
items.imageAlt: NVIDIA DGX Spark box photo on Future Computer

items.title: Pegasus lists ASUS Ascent GX10 4TB at HK$59,999
items.summary: 飛馬電腦頁面標示 ASUS Ascent GX10 4TB（CS-AGX10C、一年上門保）HK$59,999。與 Fortress 早前約 HK$43,999–43k 級報價不同，屬另一零售渠道／配置頁；落單前應核對容量、保養同是否現貨。
items.note: Price checked afternoon 2026-11-03 HKT; differs from Fortress listing covered Nov 2
items.imageAlt: ASUS Ascent GX10 product image on Pegasus

items.title: ACTRA Mag 4G AI pendant opens US early-bird access from $199.9
items.summary: Stavecho 旗下 ACTRA 開放 Mag 4G AI 吊墜美國早鳥：首 2,000 部早鳥價 $199.9（含六個月 AI Plus／4G 套餐），亦可 $19.9 訂金鎖早鳥。產品主打獨立 4G eSIM、長期記憶同 agent 執行，約 22g。
items.note: PR Newswire timestamp Nov 2, 2026 10:15 ET → HKT ~23:15
items.imageAlt: ACTRA Mag 4G pendant promotional photo

items.title: TOZO AIVU AI glasses launch Nov 3 with tinted waveguide lens claim
items.summary: TOZO 新聞稿稱 AIVU AI 眼鏡 11 月 3 日喺官網、Amazon 等平台開賣，主打自稱「全球首款」染色波導鏡片、約 45g、語音同視覺識別，並強調即時處理、唔儲存原始影像。價格未喺稿內列明。
items.note: Release wire dated Nov 2 09:00 AM; launch day stated as Nov 3 2026
items.imageAlt: TOZO AIVU AI glasses promotional image

items.title: Trajectory raises $45M Series A at $300M valuation for continual post-training
items.summary: Stanford 背景創企 Trajectory 完成 Sequoia 領投 $4,500 萬 A 輪（估值約 $3 億），NVIDIA、Bessemer、Bain Capital Ventures 參與。平台讓非技術專家用反饋持續後訓練開源模型，客戶包括 Harvey、Rogo、Decagon、Mercor、NVIDIA。
items.note: TechCrunch 3:13 PM PST Nov 2 → HKT Nov 3 ~07:13
items.imageAlt: Trajectory team photo

items.title: New York Times sues Brave over alleged AI scraping and paywall bypass
items.summary: 《紐約時報》喺曼克頓聯邦法院起訴 Brave，指其爬取並向 AI 客戶出售索引內容，兼協助用戶繞過付費牆；訴狀點名 Anthropic、Perplexity、Mistral、xAI、Cohere 為客戶但非被告。同日《Daily News》等亦提出類似訴訟。
items.note: TechCrunch 11:19 AM PST Nov 2 → HKT Nov 3 ~03:19
items.imageAlt: Brave browser illustration

items.title: 42AI exits stealth with $62.5M for behavioral world model used by brokerages
items.summary: 以色列創企 42AI 以約 $6,250 萬種子資金公開，聲稱開發可預測個人行為傾向嘅「behavioral world model」，先喺證券經紀部署管理流動性同對沖。創辦人指融資多年累積、部分來自創辦人家族相關基金；準確度聲明需謹慎解讀。
items.note: TechCrunch 8:30 AM PST Nov 2 → HKT Nov 3 ~00:30
items.imageAlt: 42AI founders photo

items.title: Omen AI acquires Aquatic Labs for $16M to monitor AI data-center cooling water
items.summary: Omen AI 以約 $1,600 萬現金加股票收購 Aquatic Labs，整合即時水質／鹼度感測，服務數據中心冷卻監控。雙方期望明年初推出整合感測器；創辦人指目前項目多已融資，短期情緒波動影響較小。
items.note: TechCrunch 7:00 AM PST Nov 2 → HKT ~23:00 Nov 2
items.imageAlt: Omen AI hardware photo

items.title: OpenAI launches Grid Protectors Program for flexible AI campus power demand
items.summary: OpenAI 推出 Grid Protectors，計劃令未來算力園區喺電網受壓時減載；佐治亞 Effingham 項目協議包括最多約 1,000MW 需求響應，並承諾支付所需基建同電力服務成本。園區仍在發展中，Effingham 作試點。
items.imageAlt: OpenAI Grid Protectors Program social card

items.title: OpenAI more than quadruples midpoints of Security Bug Bounty reward ranges
items.summary: OpenAI 提高 Security Bug Bounty：核心產品關鍵漏洞最高可達 $30,000，例外個案連 bonus 可至約 $172,000，並加入報告質素、忠誠度同優先活動乘數；過去 30 日已發放個案或會補差價。
items.imageAlt: OpenAI bug bounty announcement card

items.title: OpenAI prepares next internal security sprint with Cathedral researchers
items.summary: OpenAI 宣布籌備下一輪內部安全衝刺，聯同 Cathedral 用自家模型挑戰防禦；並重提上輪曾調動約四分一產品工程師同用 Codex 重現漏洞。文中亦提到為前線防衛者提供六個月合共約 $10 億資助存取。
items.imageAlt: OpenAI security sprint announcement card

items.title: OpenAI appoints former Army Secretary Dan Driscoll as national security counselor
items.summary: OpenAI 任命前美國陸軍部長 Dan Driscoll 為 Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization，協助同政府、業界同盟友推進「民主 AI」實務現代化，並協助內部理解國家安全機構操作需要。
items.imageAlt: Dan Driscoll joins OpenAI announcement card

items.title: NVDA closes Nov 2 at $202.06 (−1.26%) after US markets reopen
items.summary: Yahoo Finance 顯示 NVIDIA 喺 11 月 2 日（美股假期後重開）收報 $202.06，跌 1.26%；前一交易日 10 月 30 日收 $204.64。呢度只係報價記錄，唔係投資建議。
items.note: Regular-session close Nov 2 2026 $202.06 from Yahoo quote/history; EST close → HKT Nov 3 ~05:00

items.title: AMD closes Nov 2 at $466.84 (−7.52%); AVGO $322.23 (−1.18%)
items.summary: Yahoo Finance：AMD 11 月 2 日收 $466.84（跌 7.52%），Broadcom 收 $322.23（跌 1.18%）。AMD 財政第三季業績安排同日美股收市後；截至本批次產出時（香港時間下午）仍未以正式業績稿入選。
items.note: AMD $466.84 / AVGO $322.23 Nov 2 closes from Yahoo; AMD Q3 call after US close Nov 3 not yet included

items.title: CNBC: Anthropic amended S-1 shows about $17B Q3 revenue and $895.4B compute commitments
items.summary: CNBC 報道 Anthropic 修訂 S-1 披露截至 9 月 30 日九個月收入約 $332.4 億、第三季約 $170 億；同期淨虧損仍大，並披露算力／基建相關承諾支出合計約 $8,954 億。IPO 股數同價格區間仍未定。
items.note: CNBC published Mon Nov 2 2026 9:32 AM EST → HKT ~22:32
items.imageAlt: Anthropic-related photo on CNBC

items.title: ArcheAge Chronicles enters Steam Early Access November 3
items.summary: XLGAMES 嘅動作 MMO《ArcheAge Chronicles》今日起喺 Steam 搶先體驗；開局有 Diamond Shores、Gylden Ruins、Astron Plains 三區同四職業八武器，官方估計 EA 約 9–12 個月。
items.note: Steam planned unlock ~PST afternoon Nov 3; Gematsu Oct dating confirms Nov 3 EA.
items.imageAlt: ArcheAge Chronicles Steam capsule art

items.title: Death at Fleming Manor forensic mystery launches November 3
items.summary: SUPERTHUMb 嘅 1959 英國莊園法醫謎題《Death at Fleming Manor》今日喺 Steam 上線；玩家勘查現場、填寫死亡證明同緊急報告，美術走 60 年代歐陸偵探漫畫風。
items.note: Steam unlock ~11:00 UTC Nov 3 per Games Press; spoiler embargo to Nov 10 noted on store.
items.imageAlt: Death at Fleming Manor Steam capsule art

items.title: Dungeons & Dynasties Early Access: D&D meets Football Manager
items.summary: Bretticus82 嘅公會經營模擬《Dungeons & Dynasties》今日喺 Steam 搶先體驗；自稱 DnD 加 Football Manager，72 支對手公會、永久死亡同世代編年史，預計約一年 EA。
items.note: Steam Early Access Nov 3; AI used for some text/code per store disclosure.
items.imageAlt: Dungeons & Dynasties Steam capsule art

items.title: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered launches on Switch 2, PC and consoles
items.summary: Atari 同 Pipeworks 嘅《Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered》今日上線；任天堂 eShop 列出 Switch 2 數位版 US$29.99，12 隻怪獸、8 個場景，支援本機最多 4 人同新增線上對戰。
items.note: US Nintendo eShop lists Nov 3, 2026; Nintendo AU November roundup lists 4 Nov (region/timezone). Steam also dated Nov 3. Image omitted—eShop hero not cleanly captured.

items.note: Steam calendar / store dating Nov 4; image deferred until fetch of capsule.

items.title: Kick cozy soccer side-scroller launches November 3 on Steam
items.summary: 瑞士獨立團隊 nospacelost 嘅手繪足球橫向動作《Kick》今日上架 Steam；玩家帶住個波穿過 23 關返學，結合跑跳同控球解謎。
items.note: Steam planned Nov 3; Games Press / MonsterVine confirm date.
items.imageAlt: Kick Steam capsule art

items.title: Loftia cozy multiplayer life-sim enters Early Access November 3
items.summary: Qloud Games 嘅浮空島生活模擬《Loftia》今日喺 Steam／Epic 搶先體驗；主線四章覆蓋 Loftia City、Hanging Gardens、Gridfall，強調可持續耕作、裝修同多人社區專案。
items.note: Steam lists Nov 3, 2026; also Mac. loftia.gg EA page cited 1 PM EST unlock.
items.imageAlt: Loftia Steam capsule art

items.title: Mycelarium incremental fungal network game launches November 3
items.summary: PLAN KAPKAN 嘅增量探索《Mycelarium》今日上架 Steam；由一棵蘑菇開始鋪菌絲、解鎖自動化同突變，節奏偏冥想、無硬性失敗。
items.imageAlt: Mycelarium Steam capsule art

items.title: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor dated November 6 on Steam and GOG
items.summary: 經典 D&D 回合制 RPG《Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor》數位修復版定於 11 月 6 日登陸 Steam；Steam 頁列出寬螢幕／手掣支援，並有可帶進度免費 demo。
items.note: Steam dating Nov 6; RPG Site/GOG corroborate. Capsule fetch returned generic Steam share image—imageUrl null.

items.title: Potato Please first-person potato-peeling sim launches November 3
items.summary: Golden Horn Studios 嘅第一人稱削薯仔模擬《Potato Please》今日上架 Steam；由人手削皮做到機械自動化，用物理碰撞處理削皮同入桶。
items.imageAlt: Potato Please Steam capsule art

items.title: Ramen Shop Simulator enters Early Access November 3
items.summary: Sannin Interactive 嘅拉麵店經營模擬《Ramen Shop Simulator》今日喺 Steam 搶先體驗；由打掃、煮麵到裝修舊巷舖位，官方估計約 18 個月後完整版。
items.note: Steam Early Access Nov 3.
items.imageAlt: Ramen Shop Simulator Steam capsule art

items.title: Traffic Architect traffic-design sim launches November 3
items.summary: Green Signal Games 嘅《Traffic Architect》今日喺 Steam 上線；玩家鋪路、調燈號同建公交／鐵路／地鐵，城市會自行增長並產生新車流。
items.imageAlt: Traffic Architect Steam capsule art

items.title: Beat For Speed rhythm racer launches on Steam with song import and Live Audio Mode
items.summary: CyanCoast 嘅節奏競速《Beat For Speed》已於 11 月 2 日上架 Steam；可匯入歌曲或用 Live Audio Mode 跟住本機播放即時成關，並支援關卡編輯器同 Steam Workshop。
items.note: Steam store lists Released Nov 2, 2026; 20% launch discount visible on fetch.
items.imageAlt: Beat For Speed Steam capsule art

items.title: Brotato: Primal Dread DLC out now on Steam
items.summary: Blobfish／Evil Empire 嘅《Brotato: Primal Dread》DLC 已於 11 月 2 日上架；新叢林地圖 20 波、10 角色、17 武器同 40 道具，主機／手機版預計 2027 年初。
items.note: Requires base Brotato; Gematsu Oct piece called it Primal Dead in headline but Steam title is Primal Dread.
items.imageAlt: Brotato: Primal Dread Steam capsule art

items.title: The Farmer Was Replaced hits iOS/Android with The Miner Was Replaced DLC
items.summary: 百萬銷編程農場模擬《The Farmer Was Replaced》已登陸 iOS／Android，並同步附送《The Miner Was Replaced》地下採礦 DLC；手機版有自訂觸控鍵盤同藍牙鍵盤支援，試玩後一次買斷約 US$8.99。

items.title: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered dated December 3 with Tarnished Mirror campaign
items.summary: Atari／Nightdive／Eidos Montréal 宣布《Thief: The Dark Project Remastered》12 月 3 日登陸 PC、PS5／PS4、Xbox Series、Switch 2／Switch；同日附 Black Parade 團隊製作嘅新章節 The Tarnished Mirror，標準版約 US$29.99。
items.note: Gematsu Nov 2 10:21 AM EST → 23:21 HKT. Games Press confirms Tarnished Mirror day-one.
items.imageAlt: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered key art

items.title: Phantom Blade Zero tops 4 million sales in 72 hours
items.summary: S-GAME 宣布武俠動作 RPG《Phantom Blade Zero》喺上市 72 小時銷量超過 400 萬份；遊戲 10 月 29 日以數位版登陸 PS5 同 PC（Steam／Epic），實體 PS5 版預計 2027。
items.note: Gematsu Nov 1 9:59 PM EST → Nov 2 10:59 HKT. Concurrent-player figures vary by outlet; sales figure from S-GAME via Gematsu.
items.imageAlt: Phantom Blade Zero 4 million sales announcement art

items.title: Borderlands franchise surpasses 100 million units sold
items.summary: 2K 同 Gearbox 宣布《Borderlands》系列累計銷量突破 1 億套；團隊表示《Borderlands 4》Year 1 路線圖完成後，2027 年仍會有更多內容，11 月 6 日起重啟 The Hunt 慈善活動。
items.note: Article dated Monday Nov 2, 2026; official 2k.com page returned 403 to fetch tool.
items.imageAlt: Borderlands series 100 million sales news image

items.title: Ask the Developer Vol. 24 Part 2 details Ocarina of Time Switch 2 remake approach
items.summary: 任天堂官方「開發者に訊きました」Vol.24 第二篇公開；團隊以「畫面可變、體驗不變」重製《時之笛》，並談木偶／特攝質感美術同分區地圖設計。第三、四篇預定 11 月 3 日。
items.note: Official EN page dated 11/02/26; Parts 3–4 flagged for Nov 3. No clean og:image in fetch.

items.title: Nintendo cut added warp points from Ocarina of Time Switch 2 remake
items.summary: 任天堂開發者訪談透露，《薩爾達傳說 時之笛》Switch 2 重製一度加入新傳送點，但測試後覺得少咗探索發現，青沼英二叫團隊全部刪走；遊戲 11 月 5 日發售。
items.note: Quotes Aonuma from Ask the Developer series; Part 2 page on nintendo.com (fetched) did not include this passage—Parts 3–4 were due Nov 3. Marked uncertain pending official EN part with the quote.

items.title: Survival: Fountain of Youth free co-op update live on Steam
items.summary: Twin Sails／Odinsoft 為《Survival: Fountain of Youth》推出免費 2–4 人合作更新；首發三大區域，另外兩區稍後加入。現有 Steam 擁有者免費，Epic 數週內跟進，PS／Xbox 預計 2027，同期 Steam 六五折至 11 月 16 日。

items.title: Nintendo AU November roundup: OoT remake, Stellar Blade, Metaphor and more
items.summary: 任天堂澳洲 11 月 2 日更新 11 月陣容：5 日有《時之笛》重製、Stellar Blade Complete Edition、Guardians of the Galaxy Encore；12 日有 Pikmin 4 Switch 2 Edition 同 Metaphor: ReFantazio 等。

items.title: Fortnite Treasure Hunters mini-season live with One Piece crossover
items.summary: Epic 11 月 1 日開跑 Treasure Hunters 迷你賽季：新 80 人 Crossbones Isle、路飛／索隆等 One Piece 能力，Battle Pass 有 Ace 同 Nico Robin；賽季至約 12 月 5 日章節終章活動。
items.note: Official Fortnite news; GameSpot Nov 2 covers player-count rebound. Distinct from prior Pirate Shop Access item.

items.title: GameSpot: Treasure Hunters surge puts Fortnite on track for best month since OG 2023
items.summary: GameSpot 指 One Piece 主題 Treasure Hunters 令 Battle Royale 週日平均人數較近月高約四倍，週一再升；寶箱可抽兩週全 Item Shop 免費通行證，同時回調 Sprite 戰力同槍池手感。
items.note: GameSpot Nov 2 4:22 PM PST → Nov 3 08:22 HKT. Player multiples are outlet estimates.

items.title: Steam October survey: Linux share near 4%; CachyOS leads distros
items.summary: GamingOnLinux 整理 10 月 Steam 調查：Linux 佔比升至 3.95%（+0.90），Windows 93.70%；發行版以 CachyOS 16.39% 居首，其次 SteamOS Holo、Arch。同一調查亦列出 Steam Frame VR 數據。
items.note: Article 2 Nov 2026 7:48 am UTC → 15:48 HKT.
items.imageAlt: Steam logo for hardware survey coverage

items.title: GamesNewsly: Nov 2–9 Steam week highlights Godzilla, ArcheAge, Loftia
items.summary: GamesNewsly 整理 11 月 2–9 日 Steam 重點檔期：3 日有 Godzilla 重製、ArcheAge Chronicles、Loftia、Death at Fleming Manor 等；整週以 PC／獨立／Early Access 為主。
items.note: Roundup dated Nov 2, 2026; used as industry calendar context, not as sole source for individual launches.

items.title: Steam Frame jumps to 6th most-used VR headset in October survey
items.summary: PC Gamer 引述 10 月 Steam 硬件調查：Steam Frame 佔 VR 頭顯 4.13%（上月 0.41%），升至第 6，僅次於各款 Quest、Index 同 Pico 4；兩款容量仍顯示延期／候補。
items.note: Published 2 Nov 2026; survey is October 2026 snapshot.
